name: auryn-ruby
summary: Ruby language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-ruby engine extracting modules/classes/methods/functions/parameters/fields/constants, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS/INCLUDES), require graph (IMPORTS), and calls. A deep pass (a real Ruby loader / Sorbet / RBS symbol resolver for method dispatch and receiver types) is the planned second phase -- Ruby is dynamic, so the fast pass is name-based only.
